chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah, from Abdullah ibn Jabalah, from Abu al-Mi'za, from Ibrahim ibn Maymun, from Salim al-Ashall, that he heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying:

"Indeed, Allah included the parents among all the inheritors, so Allah did not deduct anything from them of the sixth, and He included the husband and the wife, so He did not deduct them from the quarter and the eighth."

key_terms.أَهْلِ اَلْمَوَارِيثِ: The inheritors (those entitled to a share of the estate)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of parents being included in inheritance according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that parents are granted their fixed one-sixth share as a divine guarantee, ensuring they are not excluded by other heirs even when competing claims arise. This narration underscores the stability of these specific portions within the Shia jurisprudence of inheritance, distinguishing the parents' guaranteed share from the variable shares of spouses.
